title: Spec.fromWasm uses the first contractspecv0 section and ignores the others

target.versions_affected: 16.3.0 - 16.4.1, 17.2.0 - 17.2.1 (executed; earlier versions not run; the 16.x line has no fix)

severity_basis: Acceptance of invalid input: a Wasm with two contractspecv0 sections gives this SDK a different interface than a tool that reads the last section or both, so calls can be encoded for a spec other tools do not show. Fixed in 17.3.0 (pull request #1827); not on the 16.x line.

entries.expected: refuse a Wasm with more than one contractspecv0 section (SEP-48: the interface is stored in one section)
entries.observed: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1, 16.4.1, 17.2.0 and 17.2.1: contract.Spec.fromWasm returns the first section's interface (function first) and ignores the second (function second), with no error. 17.3.0 and 17.4.0 refuse the Wasm.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --columns 'js@*' --entries 'contract-spec/two-spec-sections'), spec level, on js@16.3.0 - 16.4.1 and js@17.2.0 - 17.2.1.
evidence.post_fix: js@17.3.0 and js@17.4.0 refuse the Wasm (spec level conforms, reason spec_sections).
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-48 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/ecosystem/sep-0048.md#wasm-custom-section): the contract interface is stored in one contractspecv0 Wasm custom section.

reproduction.method: The kit's offline conformance runs of 2026-11-14 (make verify-conformance and the public column set) fail the 5 listed report rows as recorded, and the fixed versions 17.3.0 and 17.4.0 refuse the Wasm. The upstream issue carries its own reproduction and the merged fix.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream (pull request #1827, released in 17.3.0); the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added. The 16.x maintenance line receives critical security fixes only (js-stellar-sdk SECURITY.md); no backport request is drafted unless a maintainer decides to ask for one.

history.note: Created by xcc findings new from the known divergences that reference https://github.com/stellar/js-stellar-sdk/issues/1826 and their failure rows.
The upstream item already records this defect.
